title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: Jorge’s teacher asks him to plot all the ordered pairs \((w, l)\) of positive integers for which \(w\) is the width and \(l\) is the length of a rectangle with area \(12.\) What should his graph look like?

solutions.text:
The positive integer factor pairs \((w,l)\) with \(wl=12\) are \((1,12),\) \((2,6),\) \((3,4),\) \((4,3),\) \((6,2),\) and \((12,1)\).

These points form a decreasing set of six points, and only graph A matches them.

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: List the positive integer factor pairs of \(12\).
Remember that \((w,l)\) and \((l,w)\) are different plotted points when the factors differ.
